Olivia (Acme): Hey team — ran a streaming generate yesterday and our credits didn't change. Account acct_acme_42. Request IDs: r_8f3c2, r_8f3c2-resume. Seen 200 OK, received tokens, but balance shows same. Started ~2026-11-30 21:02 UTC. Can someone check?

Marta (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl you used and the response headers? Also which SDK or custom client?

Olivia (Acme): Using our node client (custom) with chunked streaming. Minimal curl I used to repro:

```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_acme123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-mini\",\"stream\":true,\"prompt\":\"summarize...\"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Response body streamed, final chunk looks like `{\"event\":\"done\",\"request_id\":\"r_8f3c2\"}` and client logs 200. Headers I see: `x-request-id: r_8f3c2`, no idempotency-key set.

Marta (Support): Thanks — forwarding to billing & infra. @Ravi any ledger hits for acct_acme_42 around that window?

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Checked ledger for acct_acme_42 and request_id r_8f3c2 — no debit entries. Sequence: gateway accepted streaming session, several partial events, then closed. There's an existing safety which only writes debit on session finalize event (event_type=stream_finalize). If the finalize didn't arrive or was lost, ledger isn't updated.

Marta (Support): I pulled proxy logs for that session, looks like connection closed before we emitted `stream_finalize` to billing:

```
[2026-11-30T21:02:12Z] proxy session start id=r_8f3c2
[2026-11-30T21:02:13Z] downstream chunk id=r_8f3c2 chunk=1
[2026-11-30T21:02:15Z] downstream chunk id=r_8f3c2 chunk=2
[2026-11-30T21:02:16Z] client disconnected (graceful)
[2026-11-30T21:02:16Z] session closed without stream_finalize id=r_8f3c2
```

Marta (Support): Repro steps for engineering: start streaming, then close connection immediately after receiving final data (client-side graceful close). In some cases the finalize message race is dropped and billing never records debit.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): This matches a known edge bug (ENG-1234) where streaming finalize is delivered asynchronously and can be lost if the client aggressively closes the TCP connection. Short-term mitigation: use non-streaming commit (stream=false) or ensure client waits for final ack / sends `idempotency-key` so server can reconcile. Long-term fix: infra will add stronger finalize ack and ledger idempotency.

Marta (Support): For this customer I can apply a manual credit for the tokens consumed. @Ravi OK to grant 1,200 token-credit for acct_acme_42? I'll note the ledger ticket.

Ravi (Billing-Eng): Approved. Please include original request ids in the memo. I'll create a manual debit/credit adjusting entry and link ENG-1234.

Marta (Support): Done — created entry #BILL-2026-778 with memo "manual credit for missing streaming finalize — reqs r_8f3c2". Temporarily granted 1200 token credits. Olivia, you should see the balance update shortly.

Olivia (Acme): I can confirm balance updated — thanks! We'll add idempotency keys in our SDK and pause client-close until ack. Appreciate the quick help :pray:

Marta (Support): Great. I'll keep this thread pinned to the ticket. Follow-up: engineering will prioritize ENG-1234 to ensure finalize ack persists before connection close. Closing here, reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

ledger-bot: action=credit_applied account=acct_acme_42 amount=1200 reason="missing_stream_finalize" reference=BILL-2026-778
